integrity: Mathematical proof uses standard symplectic normal forms, finite cancellation, tensor-product homology and alternating-form orbit counts; the standalone finite-field verifier supports, but does not establish, the infinite assertions. No external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic-two elementary abelian two-group algebras; arbitrary fields for structural assertions, finite fields of order a power of two for counts. Rigidity proved exactly when alternating quadratic-symbol nullity is at most two; for larger nullity explicit nonrigid lifts exist but full distribution is not determined. Four-generator complete census only. Publication priority provisional; no independent validation.
title: Sharp quadratic-symbol rank rigidity in elementary abelian two-group algebras
